_about: The pattern library (2026-09-10): reusable interaction recipes measured in the joint validation loop. One entry per pattern: how to recognise it on a parsed row (match), the keyword form and the xpath form CRT runs (placeholders: {label} {value} {index} {xpath} {attr_<name>} {anchor_kw} and any key in args), the read-back, the wait signal, the known failure, and the pages it held on. Entries are ordered specific -> general; the first match wins. The library never edits the parser: it is the interaction layer over what the parser found. Consumers: tools/recorder/patterns.py (match/recipe), review_table.py build (stamps row.pattern), robot_call (recipe when a row has no corrected call), the recorder's draft step. {anchor_kw} (2026-09-18) is D4's slot on any keyword form that locates by {label}/{label_base}: it renders '    anchor=<n>' when the row's group_size > 1 and '' when it occurs once -- pattern_library.recipe() computes it via disambiguation_args.to_call_kwargs, so a repeated control always carries QWeb's numeric anchor and a single one never does, matching the doctrine generic composers (compose_live._anchor_of, review_table.robot_call) already enforce outside the library. Found as a gap in native-select-dropdown (a select whose label group_size > 1 emitted no anchor at all); fixed there and audited into every other recipe that locates by {label}/{label_base}: clarity-lookup, adjacent-span-label-button, count-suffixed-button, tab-with-count-in-same-node. A recipe that locates by an attribute or an xpath (inline-edit-pencil, slotted-text-button-by-value, dueling-list-hand-built, pill-combobox-click-then-text) or a fixed literal (lightning-modal-cancel-and-close) is not in scope for this slot -- its locator does not resolve by the row's own label text.

NO static DOM shape distinguishes this set: Contract Term/Renewal Notice (rows 42-43, raw `class="slds-input slds-combobox__input" lwc-1gdi1otktqg=""`) carry the IDENTICAL class and type as the non-reactive Start Date/End Date comboboxes (rows 50/51/54/55/58/59/62/63, same `slds-input slds-combobox__input` class, type=text) -- only the per-component `lwc-<hash>` scoping token differs, and that token is a generated compiler fingerprint per component/build, never a shape (CLAUDE.md's own locator doctrine: 'generated attribute values are never locators'); Amount x3/Approved Budget x2 (rows 44-48, raw `class="slds-input" lwc-1gdi1otktqg=""`) carry no attribute (no data-*, no aria-*, no wrapper class) that a plain non-reactive text input elsewhere would lack. The re-render-on-keystroke behaviour is real (measured live, see known_failure) but is JS runtime behaviour, invisible in the static captured markup that a recorder/composer sees before it ever types into the field. roster_order._about: LOOP 3 / A4 (2026-09-20): per-platform locator-roster order, measured from the live verdicts already recorded in docs/recorder/review/*/review.json (the keyword track: row.live.keyword against calls[0] -- tier1 label keyword when calls[0].keyword != 'ClickItem', tier2 attribute keyword when it is 'ClickItem'; the xpath track: row.xpath.live against row.xpath.rung, grouped tier3 anchored-on-text-or-attribute (unique_preceding_text/text_node/text_tag/scoped_text/sibling_scope/stable_attr/scoped_attr/scoped_attr_positional), tier4 parent-label (label_association/scoped_label), tier5 positional (structural/positional_last_resort). Ranked by the 95% Wilson LOWER BOUND (tools/benchmark/metrics.wilson), not the raw rate, among tiers with n(pass+bug)>=10; a tier under 10 is listed last with note 'n too small'. Full measurement: docs/audit/roster-order-2026-09-20.md, atoms: docs/audit/roster-order/atoms-2026-09-20.jsonl. CAVEAT carried forward from that report: the xpath track's rung was already filtered for uniqueness before being live-tested (row.xpath.rung is the FIRST ladder rung that was unique_in_capture); the keyword track's hint (calls[0]) carries no equivalent pre-filter. tier3 ranking #1 on every platform here is consistent with that construction bias as well as with a real effect, and this measurement cannot separate the two. Consumed by tools/recorder/pattern_library.py:roster_form_for_platform() only when GZ_ROSTER_BY_PLATFORM=1 (default OFF, D-2026-09-20). No entry here is prescriptive: it describes what was measured, same doctrine as the locator hints themselves (D14).

shape_rules._about: THE SHAPE-RULE TABLE (2026-10-10): per Salesforce shape a person would name, the keyword form that solves it in any org, the conditions the form needs, its landing evidence by org and cloud, and a status. Keyword first (the user, 2026-10-10: "if we know that every carrot menu is solved by this keyword ... that should be the de facto"); the unique relative xpath is the in-place answer only where no keyword can (xpath_in_place_why) and is always the final backup. Each rule `match`es census shape signatures (tools/recorder/shape_census.py: region, family, tag, keyword, label_source, role, host, pattern); rules are ordered specific -> general and the first match wins. The hand-written half is id, name, kind, match, ladder, conditions, keyword_reaches, xpath_in_place_why, notes; `generated` (evidence, forms on record, status, provenance) is written by `tools/recorder/shape_rules.py build` and never hand-edited. Status (decided on VALIDATED landings only, D27): PROVEN-EVERYWHERE = the lead form landed in >= 2 orgs and in every org it was tried in; PROVEN-SOME = landed in one org; CONFLICTING = some org tried it and it failed there; UNTESTED = no validated attempt. Consumers: tools/recorder/shape_rules.py (load, rule_for, render_call, status).
